visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a plaid shirt stands outside a McDonald's, gesturing and speaking enthusiastically to the camera. The street background is slightly blurred. (2) He displays a specific Pokémon card featuring Pikachu at McDonald's close to the lens, showing details of the illustration. (3) He is seen at a service counter interacting with a staff member's hand; a large 'Sold Out' overlay appears over his surprised face. (4) He walks through various urban streets at night, his expression shifting from frustration to determination as text overlays explain his search. (5) He ascends an escalator, smiling broadly as text indicates he has successfully located a third-party seller. (6) A close-up shows hands holding multiple unopened Pokémon card packs, then he holds one up to his face, beaming with pure joy. (7) Indoors in a room, he reveals two cards from a pack, pointing specifically at a Pikachu card with an expression of absolute awe. (8) He sits on a dark sofa, handing a card pack to a friend; the friend reacts with intense surprise and shows his phone screen which displays the same card.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic male voice introduces a limited-edition item over a fast-paced pop electronic track. Speech is rapid with frequent rising intonation. (2) The tone shifts to mock-sadness with a percussive 'Sold Out' sound effect, accompanied by faint ambient street noise. (3) The speaker's excitement returns at a high intensity as he describes finding a private seller; the BGM becomes more uplifting and melodic. (4) An explosive vocal peak occurs during the reveal, followed by rapid-fire narration about the card's secondary market value. (5) In an indoor setting, two male voices interact with high vocal arousal and laughter. A synthesized 'Pikachu' vocal sound effect is heard as a comedic punctuation to the friend's reaction.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Resolution -> Reveal -> Sharing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the high-effort personal experience of acquiring a rare, limited-edition Pokémon card from a McDonald's collaboration in Japan, concluding with the emotional reward of sharing it with a fellow fan.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Content focuses on personal struggle and genuine excitement over a collection hobby rather than a paid promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-energy collection-themed vlog utilizing social media editing conventions to create a sense of urgency and triumph.
